clues.text: This coaster reaches a maximum speed of 62 mph, stands 150 feet high, and features a single inversion along its track.
Built by manufacturer Premier Rides, this attraction debuted to riders in 2019.
Thrill-seekers can find this coaster in the state of Florida.
Located at Busch Gardens Tampa, this launched steel coaster was the tallest launched coaster in Florida until VelociCoaster debuted in 2021.
This coaster's name evokes a fierce striped big cat, having been trademarked alongside names like Twisted Tiger.

evidence.quote: '''Tigris''' is a [[steel]] [[launched]] [[roller coaster]] located at [[Busch Gardens Tampa]] in Tampa, Florida, USA.
It was the tallest launched roller coaster in Florida until [[VelociCoaster]] at [[Universal's Islands of Adventure]] opened in 2021.
In March 2018, [[SeaWorld Parks & Entertainment]] filed three trademark applications for the names ''Tigris'', ''Uproar'', and ''Twisted Tiger''.
